day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the friend who always says yes
signs.message: She's never once said no. Call her, make tonight happen.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a code sent to an old phone
signs.message: The code landed on your old phone. Go dig it out.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.message: Keep walking to the last car. Room to stretch out.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a dinner you offered to host
signs.message: You offered to host. Name the date today, before it drifts.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.message: One signature between you and done. Handle it before lunch.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Tell them you're out by ten. Then actually leave.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the second half of the day
signs.message: Morning's half gone. Put your one real task after lunch.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the corner shop nobody goes to
signs.message: That empty little shop you always pass. Go in, buy something.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nothing on that pharmacy list is urgent. Tomorrow's fine.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You already know the one that works. Make that, nothing new.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The follow-up slides another day. Nothing collapses, it just waits.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Everyone's gone and the room's wrecked. Leave it till morning.
